note: E17c predictions (PLAN-E17C Task 12), drafted from the Task 11 calibration at moca e5ae5151 on the AWS rig (chain-e17c.sh smoke .. gate-256, 2026-11-21 14:53Z .. 2026-11-22 12:54Z, rc 0): N=1 baselines + class probes at pycache for sbx, ship-300 and ship-300-nd (evaluable seeds s1-s3, s7; s4-s6 empty_window in every arm), and the two gates. Not sealed until the user approves.

calibration.host: AWS m7i.metal-24xl, 96 vCPU, 377 GiB, /srv/e15 XFS reflink, profile fresh-metal

pycache_n1_cal.basis: latency_report.py over N1-s1,s2,s3,s7 per arm, in-window ok calls

vm_fp_cal.basis: vm_age_lease.json fpr per ship rung N1-s1..s7
vm_fp_cal.fp_45s_readings_per_rung: 0-3 (about half the heavy Execs: no next call within 45 s)
vm_fp_cal.smoke_check: vm_fp <= vm_mem on every reading (180/180/382); up to 385 MiB per VM left out as reclaimable host cache

gate_pycache_low.per_seed_in_window_calls: 0-1 py_short+py_import per seed, both arms, with E15_START_ZERO=1 and an 1800 s window
gate_pycache_low.need: 3 per seed with >=1 of each; 5 of each pooled

gate_256.result: py_analyze OOM-killed 20 of 20 runs at every ANALYZE_WORK_SCALE in 32,16,8,4,2,1, in both sbx and ship-300; no peak RSS (killed)

criterion_thresholds.5a_prime: PASS iff ship-300 pycache pooled (evaluable N1-l<k> + N128-lat) share_true_fp >= 0.50 AND pinned_share_fp_45s <= 0.50 (all heavy +45 s readings at >= 0.9 of guest RAM, pooled by counts; R-p)
criterion_thresholds.2_prime: PASS iff ship-300 median warm py_short gain >= 0.50 and py_import gain >= 0.30 against sbx at pycache, N=1 (>= 4 evaluable N1-l<k> per arm pooled, R-z2/R-z6) and N=128 (N128-lat)
criterion_thresholds.5b_prime: PASS iff every ship-* rung at pycache (N1-l<k> paired by name with sbx, N128-lat) has replacement ratio_to_sbx <= 1.5; an arm with no ratio at all is null (R-r)
criterion_thresholds.3_prime: PASS iff at squeeze, ship-300: zero memory-guard events, zero refusals with an idle lease, every reclaim of the idle-longest lease (E17b's criterion 3)
criterion_thresholds.missing: a criterion with a missing input is null, not a pass; top-level pass null if any is null

predictions.claim: 5a′ HOLDS: ship-300's pooled pinned_share_fp_45s is in [0.00, 0.20] and share_true_fp in [0.50, 1.00].
predictions.metric: verdict criteria 5a_prime (vm_age_lease fpr fp_45s_*, share_true_fp, pooled)
predictions.note: E17b: 0.536 on memory.current at +15 s. Calibration: 0.0 at N=1 (few readings). At N=128 a VM's guest cache is dropped 30 s after its last call and the host cache is not charged, so a +45 s reading should sit near the working set.

predictions.claim: F1's two halves separate: ship-300-nd's pooled pinned_share_fp_45s is in [0.10, 0.60], above ship-300's by at least 0.10.
predictions.metric: reported ship-300-nd fpr vs ship-300 (same keys)
predictions.falsifiedBy: ship-300-nd pinned_share_fp_45s outside [0.10, 0.60], or less than 0.10 above ship-300's
predictions.note: ship-300-nd keeps the guest page cache (anonymous on the host), so only the host-cache exclusion lowers its charge.

predictions.claim: 2′ HOLDS at N=1 and N=128: ship-300's warm py_short gain in [0.75, 0.95], py_import gain in [0.30, 0.50]. Reported: ship-300-nd within 0.05 of ship-300 on both.
predictions.falsifiedBy: py_short outside [0.75, 0.95] or py_import outside [0.30, 0.50] at either N; or ship-300-nd more than 0.05 from ship-300
predictions.note: Calibration 0.85 / 0.36 (py_import warm n 3, 0.06 above its bar). E17b: 0.86/0.47 (N1), 0.87/0.41 (N128). py_import is the risk.

predictions.claim: The drop's latency cost is small: ship-300's after_drop/kept median ratio is in [1.0, 1.5] for py_import and in [1.0, 3.0] for py_short at N=128.
predictions.metric: latency_report 'Warm calls by the guest's page-cache drop'
predictions.falsifiedBy: py_import ratio outside [1.0, 1.5] or py_short outside [1.0, 3.0]
predictions.note: Calibration (n 1-3): py_import 1.20, py_short 1.60 (11 vs 7 ms). A dropped cache is re-read from the host page cache.

predictions.claim: 5b′ HOLDS: every ship rung's replacement ratio_to_sbx is in [0.15, 1.0].
predictions.note: E17b 0.19-0.88; the drop does not touch the host page cache the replacement reads.

predictions.claim: 3′ HOLDS at squeeze (24576 MiB): zero memory-guard events, zero refusals with an idle lease, every reclaim of the idle-longest lease; reclaim becomes continuous (one a minute) at N >= 48.
predictions.metric: verdict criteria 3_prime; the climb's stop N
predictions.falsifiedBy: any guard event, refusal with an idle lease, or wrong reclaim; or continuous reclaim below N=48
predictions.note: E17b: continuous at N≈40; lower charges should fit more leases before reclaim.

predictions.claim: The ownership walk observed: median normalise_us of A in [50, 200] ms at 10000 files and [400, 1200] ms at 100000; B's 0.
predictions.note: E17b inferred 91 ms and 756 ms as A − B.

predictions.claim: The driver stays under 1% of host CPU (A2).
predictions.falsifiedBy: any rung's driver CPU >= 1% of host CPU

cut_before_the_seal.what: pycache-low is cut again and reported: its gate failed (0-1 qualifying calls per seed with E15_START_ZERO=1 and an 1800 s window; 1-2 of each class pooled, need 5)
cut_before_the_seal.why: at 1.5% duty an N=1 baseline needs hours-long windows; E16 covers low duty for capacity

cut_before_the_seal.what: the 256 MiB stages are cut for this run and reported: py_analyze was OOM-killed 20/20 at every ANALYZE_WORK_SCALE (32..1) in both arms
cut_before_the_seal.why: the scale is a CPU knob; the memory is the imported stack and the dataset; a 256-specific py_analyze (smaller dataset or shard) is a follow-up

open_for_the_seal: py_import's N=1 calibration gain is 0.36 on 3 warm calls, 0.06 above 2′'s 0.30 bar. Prediction 3 says 2′ holds; a miss there would be on py_import.
5a′ is judged on +45 s (criterion5a_reading plus45, user 2026-11-22): at N=1 about half the heavy Execs had no next call within 45 s; N=128 should give hundreds of readings.
sealNote: Sealed on the user's go-ahead (2026-11-22, 'Seal as drafted'), before any measured E17c rung. Decisions at the seal: criterion5a_reading plus45; pycache-low and the 256 MiB stages cut (cut_before_the_seal E17C-C1, C2).
